meta.item: Mutual aid: question or volunteer mission

mutualAid.title: Mutual aid
mutualAid.lead: Ask a practical question about life in your host country, answer other members and join the associations' volunteer missions. Answers stay here, with no contact details: private contact goes through messages.

unavailable.title: Mutual aid is not available here yet
unavailable.body: This section is not served by this data provider yet.

filter.label: Mutual aid location
filter.cityHint: Type the city: no geolocation is used.

mutualAid.noContactReminder: No phone number, email address, link or exact address: answers stay here, then go through messages if needed.
mutualAid.privateContact: To continue privately, use messages from the person's profile. No contact details are shown here.

questions.title: Questions
questions.askDescription: Your question is read by DIASPORALE members. They see your published profile, never your contact details.

open.title: No open question here
open.body: Nobody is waiting for an answer in this place right now. Ask the first question, or widen to the whole country.

resolved.title: No resolved question here
resolved.body: A question is resolved when its author picks an answer.

closed.title: No closed question here
closed.body: A closed question no longer receives answers.

mine.title: You have not asked any question
mine.body: Your questions appear here, whatever their country.

question.editDescription: The question's country does not change; the city stays optional.

closeConfirm.title: Close the question?
closeConfirm.body: Nobody will be able to answer it any more. The picked answer, if any, stays visible.

withdrawConfirm.title: Withdraw the question?
withdrawConfirm.body: Nobody will be able to read it any more, answers included. This cannot be undone.

questionForm.title: Your question
questionForm.titleHint: One clear sentence, {{max}} characters at most.
questionForm.cityHint: Type the city, or leave it empty for the whole country.

answers.emptyBody: Share what you know: a simple answer already helps.
answers.hint: {{max}} characters at most, no contact details.

withdrawConfirm.title: Withdraw your answer?
withdrawConfirm.body: It will no longer be shown. If it was the picked answer, the question becomes open again.

answers.closed: This question is closed: it no longer receives answers.
answers.cannotAnswer: To answer, your DIASPORALE membership must be declared or verified.

missions.title: Volunteer missions
missions.lead: Missions offered by DIASPORALE associations. Signing up shows your published name to the association's team, with your consent.
missions.proposeDescription: The mission is published on behalf of the association you manage.

upcoming.title: No open mission here
upcoming.body: Associations have no open mission in this place right now. Widen to the whole country, or come back soon.

mine.title: No sign-up
mine.body: The missions you sign up for appear here.

team.title: No mission for this association
team.body: Offer a first mission: it will appear here with its volunteers.

cancelSheet.title: Cancel this mission?
cancelSheet.description: Volunteers will see the cancellation and its reason. This cannot be undone.
cancelSheet.reasonHint: {{max}} characters at most, no contact details.

missionForm.pageHint: Only associations you sign for are listed here.
missionForm.title: Mission title
missionForm.descriptionHint: The tasks and what to bring, {{max}} characters at most.
missionForm.cityHint: Type the city: no geolocation is used.
missionForm.areaHint: A neighbourhood or a landmark: never an exact address.
missionForm.scheduleHint: A start date and time; an end for a period of three months at most. Times are in the chosen time zone.
missionForm.placesChangeHint: Places never go below the number of volunteers signed up.

signup.title: Take part
signup.consent: I agree that the {{page}} team sees my published name to organise this mission.
signup.registered: Your sign-up is confirmed. The {{page}} team sees your published name.

withdrawConfirm.title: Withdraw from the mission?
withdrawConfirm.body: Your place will be freed. You can sign up again while a place is left.

signup.privacy: No contact details are shared: the team will write to you through messages.

team.title: Manage the mission
team.editDescription: Volunteers keep their place; a rescheduled mission must start in the future.

closeConfirm.title: Close sign-ups?
closeConfirm.body: Volunteers stay signed up; nobody else will be able to join.

volunteers.title: Signed-up volunteers
volunteers.lead: This list is reserved for the association's team. Each volunteer agreed to show their published name here; to reach them, use messages.
volunteers.emptyBody: Sign-ups will appear here in order of arrival.

item.unavailableTitle: This mutual aid item is not available
item.unavailableBody: It may have been withdrawn, or it cannot be read from your account.

feedback.unaccepted: The answer is no longer picked.

errors.aid_title_too_short: The title is too short: say a little more.
errors.aid_contact_forbidden: No phone number, email address or link: contact goes through messages.
errors.aid_address_forbidden: No exact address: give an approximate place.
errors.aid_theme_invalid: Choose a topic from the list.
errors.aid_country_is_home: DIASPORALE mutual aid is about countries of residence, outside Gabon.
errors.aid_city_invalid: This city name cannot be read.
errors.aid_city_too_long: The city name is too long.
errors.aid_answers_limit_reached: This question has received the maximum number of answers.
errors.aid_not_author: Only the author of the question can do this.
errors.aid_version_conflict: The content changed in the meantime: reload the page, then try again.
errors.aid_question_not_resolved: No answer is picked for this question.
errors.aid_answer_locked: The picked answer can no longer be edited; you can withdraw it.
errors.aid_answer_unavailable: This answer is no longer available.
errors.aid_page_kind_not_allowed: A volunteer mission is offered on behalf of an association page.
errors.aid_mission_description_too_short: Describe the mission a little more.
errors.aid_mission_area_too_long: The approximate place is too long.
errors.aid_mission_schedule_invalid: The schedule is not valid: check the dates and times.
errors.aid_mission_start_past: The mission must start in the future.
errors.aid_mission_too_far: The mission must start within the coming year.
errors.aid_time_zone_invalid: Choose a time zone from the list.
errors.aid_mission_places_invalid: The number of places is not valid.
errors.aid_mission_places_below_signups: Places cannot go below the number of volunteers signed up.
errors.aid_mission_closed: Sign-ups for this mission are closed.
errors.aid_mission_started: The mission has started: sign-ups and withdrawals are closed.
errors.aid_signup_consent_required: Tick the box to agree that the team sees your published name.
errors.aid_signup_exists: Your sign-up for this mission is already confirmed.
errors.aid_signup_missing: There is no sign-up to withdraw for this mission.
